records.title: EvoPrune: Early-Stage Visual Token Pruning for Efficient MLLMs
records.reason: EvoPrune prunes visual tokens during MLLM encoding and reports 2x inference speedup with under 1% quality loss.

records.title: Quadtree Partitioning-based Visual Token Pruning for MLLMs Considering Information Density
records.reason: IEEE primary page exposed only robot-verification JavaScript text; abstract unavailable.

records.title: Supernodes and Halos: Loss-Critical Hubs in LLM Feed-Forward Layers
records.reason: Supernodes/Halos studies loss-critical LLM FFN channels and protected-core structured pruning.

records.title: TELL-TALE: Task Efficient LLMs with Task Aware Layer Elimination
records.reason: TALE eliminates LLM layers at inference time to reduce computation without retraining.

records.title: Transformers: A Graph Processing Perspective
records.reason: IEEE primary page exposed only robot-verification text; title alone cannot establish graph-processing relevance to LLM efficiency.

records.title: Efficient Adaptive Transformer: An Empirical Study and Reproducible Framework
records.reason: EAT combines token pruning, sparse attention and early exit for adaptive transformer inference; abstract notes shallow-model latency overhead.

records.title: Mesh-Attention: A New Communication-Efficient Distributed Attention with Improved Data Locality
records.reason: Mesh-Attention reduces distributed LLM-attention communication and reports 3.4x speedup on 256 GPUs.

records.title: EcoFormer: Energy-Saving Attention with Linear Complexity
records.reason: EcoFormer linearizes attention through binary hashing and reduces energy on language and vision tasks.

records.title: Phase-Associative Memory: Sequence Modeling in Complex Hilbert Space
records.reason: PAM is a language model but reports 4x arithmetic overhead over matched Transformer and no efficiency improvement.

records.title: Parallel Sequence Modeling via Generalized Spatial Propagation Network
records.reason: GSPN is optimized for spatial vision and image generation, not LLM inference.

records.title: TASP: Topology-aware Sequence Parallelism
records.reason: TASP increases topology utilization for long-context LLM sequence parallelism and reports up to 3.58x speedup.

records.title: Long-context vision large language models: Empirical insights and a baseline
records.reason: Official Edinburgh abstract confirms VLLM long-context baseline shortens visual input via caption aggregation and beats token-reduction/context-extension approaches.

records.title: ConfSpec: Efficient Step-Level Speculative Reasoning via Confidence-Gated Verification
records.reason: ConfSpec selectively escalates speculative reasoning verification and reports 2.24x end-to-end speedup.

records.title: OoO-Spec: Out-of-Order Semantic Speculation for Fast Tool Calling
records.reason: OoO-Spec predicts tool-call semantics in parallel and reports 2.46x-5.34x decoding speedup.

records.title: Reward-Shifted Speculative Sampling Is An Efficient Test-Time Weak-to-Strong Aligner
records.reason: Reward-shifted speculative sampling lowers test-time LLM alignment inference cost.

records.title: VideoRouter: Query-Adaptive Dual Routing for Efficient Long-Video Understanding
records.reason: VideoRouter compresses less-relevant video-frame tokens in MLLM inference, reducing tokens up to 67.9%.

records.title: KORMo: Korean Open Reasoning Model for Everyone
records.reason: KORMo focuses on synthetic-data-driven Korean-English model training, openness, and reasoning quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: NestedKV: Nested Memory Routing for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
records.reason: NestedKV compresses long-context LLM KV cache with hierarchical routing and no model changes.

records.title: Benchmarking the Energy Savings with Speculative Decoding Strategies
records.reason: This work benchmarks LLM speculative-decoding energy use, directly measuring inference efficiency.

records.title: QUARTZ: Quantile-Aware Routing and Queueing for TTFT SLOs in LLM Serving
records.reason: QUARTZ routing/queueing reduces TTFT tails and SLO violations in LLM serving.
